title: Register SSO Provider bridge drops tokenEndpoint (Google-style IdPs can never register on hosted), and request-domain-verification answers domain: ""
body:
director#1 · hotlong · session_f4c42f815d5e47b39de5e9fb0d6d7864

Filing gate: ① a defect with a named producer, measured on staging while reading cloud#4370 (hosted SSO domain verification), on the account owner's approval to run it.
Reader: the `plugin-auth` area (`packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/register-sso-provider.ts`, the Register SSO Provider bridge `POST /admin/sso/register`, and the domain-verification answer). `priority:p3`. Triage decides.
Dedupe (open and closed, objectstack): `admin/sso/register tokenEndpoint` 2 hits, #32297 (the bridge learned `userInfoEndpoint`, closed) and #8009 (clientSecret storage, closed). Neither is this. `request-domain-verification domain empty`: 30 loose hits, none about the answer's `domain`.

## 维护者速读

托管环境注册外部 IdP 时有两个小毛病：
1. 像 Google 这种 token 地址和 issuer 不在同一个域名的 IdP，注册时报错让你「填 tokenEndpoint」，但托管用的注册入口根本不收这个字段，所以永远注册不上。Okta 和 Entra 不受影响。
2. 申请域名验证的返回里 `domain` 是空字符串，界面如果按它提示「去哪个域名加记录」，就会显示空白。

## Measured (staging `os-4e4qa4`, Enterprise plan, cloud PR #4415 head `153d10ca`, objectstack 18.4.0, 2026-11-14)

1. `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/sso/register` with `issuer https://accounts.google.com`, `domain objectlab.ai`, placeholder client id/secret → **400 `SSO_REGISTER_FAILED`**: "The token_endpoint "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token" is not trusted … name it explicitly in the registration: "tokenEndpoint" … (oidcConfig.tokenEndpoint on POST /sso/register; the Register SSO Provider bridge, POST /admin/sso/register, takes userInfoEndpoint and discoveryEndpoint as fields of the same names)". Sending `tokenEndpoint` (plus `jwksEndpoint`, `authorizationEndpoint`) to the bridge gives the **same 400**: the bridge drops the field. `POST /sso/register` answers 404 on hosted, so no door takes it.
2. With a same-origin issuer (`https://login.microsoftonline.com/<tenant>/v2.0`), register → 200. Then `POST /api/v1/auth/admin/sso/request-domain-verification {providerId}` → 200 `{"providerId":"cloud4370-objectlab","domain":"","token":"…","dnsRecordType":"TXT","dnsRecordName":"_better-auth-token-cloud4370-objectlab","dnsRecordValue":"…"}`. **`domain` is `""`** although the provider was registered with `domain: objectlab.ai`. `dnsRecordName` is relative, so the domain is the only thing that says where it goes. The TXT added at `_better-auth-token-cloud4370-objectlab.objectlab.ai` then verified (200 `verified: true`), so the stored domain is right and only the answer is wrong.

## Fix direction

- The bridge accepts `tokenEndpoint`, and `jwksEndpoint` if discovery's `jwks_uri` hits the same trust rule, as it does `userInfoEndpoint`. The refusal message then names a field the door takes.
- `request-domain-verification` answers the provider's registered `domain`.

## Acceptance

1. A Google-style IdP (token endpoint on another origin) registers through `POST /admin/sso/register` when the endpoint is named.
2. The verification answer carries the registered domain.
3. Tests pin both.
